description:
Option-chain pressure map for the nearest weekly/monthly expiry — Max
    Pain, dealer Gamma Wall, likely weekly high, and an extreme squeeze target.

    Returns spot, the expiry and days to it, the option quote time (latest
    trade in the chain, UTC), max pain, gamma/call/put walls, likely weekly
    high, squeeze target, likely expiry close range, ATM IV and the weekly
    expected move. Its expiry can differ from get_iv_radar's.

    Args:
        ticker: Stock symbol, e.g. "SPY".
name: get_option_pressure
title: Options Pressure Map
